reasons: Both prompts are strong and cover every rubric item: they check the tool data first, enforce the remaining-balance and duplicate checks, send the email only after a successful refund, and apply the delivered status and 14-day rules. A handles an ambiguous or failed issue_refund more robustly: it forbids a retry and calls get_order again to see whether the refund actually went through, which guards against double payouts after a timeout. B adds useful handling for a send_email failure and an email template, but it needs more placeholders filled before use and includes the odd instruction to compare dates 'посимвольно'.
